messages:
Maya: kicking off the deploy for llm-route v3 now. plan is FF ramp: 0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~30m with health gates at each step :hourglass:
Alex: noted. which cohorts for 5% and 25%? can we target non-critical traffic first?
Maya: 5% = internal beta cohort (cohort id: beta-internal). 25% = geo-slice eu-west + small subset us-west. avoid billing and ingestion-heavy paths.
Ryan: rolling with that. recommended rollback triggers: 1) error-rate increase > 0.5% absolute over baseline 2) median latency > 2x baseline for >5m 3) any 5xx spike > 0.2% of requests.
Jen: add quality regression check too — sampling of 200 prompts, BLEU-like heuristics and a couple of golden prompts. if quality delta > threshold, abort.
Maya: agreed. I'll pin the revision to v3.0.2 in serviceconfig before we flip FF. we should keep a pinned fallback to v2.
Alex: pinging infra to ensure autoscale headroom for burst during 25% -> 100% shift.
DeployBot: @Maya initiated feature flag unlock: ff_key=llmroute_v3, starting state=off
DeployBot: creating canary rollout id=cr-1766667777, cohorts=[beta-internal], target_percent=5
Maya: command for canary (for audit):
```/deploybot rollout start --ff llmroute_v3 --cohorts beta-internal --percent 5 --timeout 900 --owner maya``` 
Alex: when we move to 25% let's run a quick perf job: `scripts/perf_check.sh --targets llmroute_v3 --samples 500`
Ryan: oncall alerting hooks: I've set quiet window to suppress noisy pagers but we'll keep paging for SLO breaches. added a slack alert to #eng-oncall and a page for severity 2+.
Jen: where will we collect sampled outputs for eval? need an S3 path with retention 7d.
Maya: s3://redwood-deploys/llmroute_v3/canary/1766667777/ — I gave devex read/write.
Alex: thumbs up. infra says GPUs have 20% spare during peak, should be fine for the ramp.
DeployBot: canary progressed: 5% -> health check 1 passed (latency/err within thresholds). next step scheduled in 10m.
Maya: schedule: wait 10m, run perf_check, run golden prompts, then +25% if clean. will leave canary open for manual abort until 25% completes.
Ryan: rollback playbook ready: `scripts/rollout/fast_disable_ff.sh llmroute_v3` — that nukes the flag to 0% and pins routing back to v2. tested in staging.
Maya: copy that. also keeping a feature gate so support can quickly opt users out if necessary.
Alex: small ask — add a short release note blurb in deploy ticket: what changed, model size delta, expected latency impact. QA will sign off before the 25% bump.
Jen: once we hit 25% I'll run the golden set and push a quick report to the thread. if any quality fail -> stop and rollback.
OncallBot: reminder — quiet window active 22:00-06:00 UTC. this deploy is inside quiet window, so be conservative and prefer manual checks.
Maya: acknowledged. will keep human in loop. starting canary now and will post updates. :eyes:
Alex: thanks — I'll monitor dashboards and have infra on standby.
Ryan: I'll watch the SLO alarms and EMO channels.
DeployBot: canary event log:
- 1766667785: rollout start
- 1766667850: health check passed
- 1766668000: perf-sample job queued
Maya: perf job completed, median latency +8%, error rate flat. golden prompts all green (0/12 regressions). pushing to 25% in 2m.
DeployBot: rolling to 25% -> cohorts: [beta-internal, eu-west-slice]
Alex: moving observability window to 15m during 25% ramp. if anything looks off we hit rollback.
Jen: running eval now.
DeployBot: 25% health check started.
Maya: 25% health check looks good at t+5m. logs clean, page-free. proceeding to 100% after 10m soak.
Ryan: keep the pinned fallback ready. if SLO breach occurs during the 25->100 step, execute `scripts/rollout/fast_disable_ff.sh` and notify customers via incident template.
Maya: understood. will call abort if any threshold fires.
OncallBot: deploy complete to 100% at 1766668120. automated telemetry shows latency stable, errors within baseline. final note: keep extra watch for 2h.
Maya: release notes:
- llm-route v3.0.2 deployed via staged FF ramp
- targeted cohorts: beta-internal, eu-west, us-west
- rollback criteria: error >0.5% / latency 2x / quality regression
- fallback pinned to v2
- contact: @Maya @Alex @Ryan
Maya: thanks team. closing thread but will post any postmortem if we see regressions. :tada:
